summary: Implemented runtime dependency metadata and regression coverage; deterministic project-ID badge colors with WCAG black/white contrast; bounded SQLite persistence and typed list/set/reset RPC with project validation and realtime signals; reconnect-aware frontend state; accessible per-project settings drafts, save/reset, filtering, conflict/error/live-region behavior; and sidebar badge styling. Dockside typecheck, 201 focused tests, and both bundles pass.

state.request: Carry forward the verified Dockside managed-install dependency fix by classifying @hugeicons/react, @hugeicons/core-free-icons, and runtime-imported zod as production dependencies with lockfile regression coverage. Also color the project letter badges in Dockside's sidebar using stable deterministic per-project fallback colors, and let users choose and persist an individual color for each project from Dockside's settings page. Key overrides by stable project ID so project renames retain the color. Validate untrusted persisted values, preserve accessible contrast, add focused logic/UI contract tests, build, and verify via local install/reload and browser screenshot.
